title: TreeHCA: Hindsight-Guided Exploration and Credit Assignment for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.12828v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Outcome-supervised group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) assigns the same advantage to every token in an LLM agent trajectory, leaving useful and unhelpful decisions undifferentiated. Hindsight credit assignment (HCA) can refine this feedback, but its estimates rely on trajectories containing informative alternatives at consequential histories. We introduce TreeHCA, which couples hindsight-guided exploration with hindsight credit assignment. TreeHCA uses changes in reference-answer likelihood to revisit intermediate histories and sample alternative continuations, forming a tree of reasoning and tool interactions. Because this exploration changes the distribution of sampled continuations, we derive the corresponding inverse-hindsight importance correction, including an exact finite-pool identity. translated_title: TreeHCA：面向多轮LLM智能体的后见之明引导探索与信用分配
translated_abstract: 基于结果监督的组相对策略优化（GRPO）为LLM智能体轨迹中的每个token分配相同的优势值，导致有用和无用的决策无法被区分。后见之明信用分配（HCA）可以细化这种反馈，但其估计依赖于在关键历史节点处包含信息性备选方案的轨迹。我们提出TreeHCA，将后见之明引导的探索与后见之明信用分配相结合。TreeHCA利用参考答案似然的变化来回访中间历史节点并采样替代性延续，从而构建一棵由推理和工具交互组成的树。由于这种探索改变了采样延续的分布，我们推导了相应的逆后见之明重要性校正，其中包括一个精确的有限池恒等式。我们将这一结构用于归一化的树回备中，将终端结果传播为轮级优势。这种共享的后见之明结构……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TreeHCA利用参考答案似然的变化引导探索，构建推理与工具交互树，并通过逆后见之明重要性校正和归一化树回备将终端结果传播为轮级优势，为多轮LLM智能体实现细粒度的后见之明信用分配，克服了GRPO对所有token分配相同优势的缺陷。
en_tdlr: TreeHCA enables fine-grained hindsight credit assignment for multi-turn LLM agents by guiding tree-structured exploration of alternative continuations via reference-answer likelihood changes, deriving inverse-hindsight importance corrections, and applying a normalized tree backup that propagates terminal outcomes into turn-level advantages, addressing GRPO's undifferentiated token-level advantage assignment.
